newsitem.title: USA: Beloit to appeal $95 mln verdict against it.
newsitem.headline: Beloit to appeal $95 mln verdict against it.

text.p: Beloit Corp, a unit of Harnischfeger Industries Inc, said Wednesday it will "vigorously appeal" a $95 million verdict to Potlatch Corp by a Lewiston, Idaho, jury.

On Tuesday, Potlatch said it was awarded $95 million for damages resulting from alleged defects and deficiencies associated with a pulp washer system that was installed at its Lewiston pulp mill. The washers were supplied by Beloit.
Beloit said the lawsuit alleged that certain large pulp line washers costing less than $15 million failed to perform satisfactorily.

"We are outraged by the verdict against Beloit, which was rendered in an environment of open and extreme hostility," James Chokey, senior vice president, law and corporate development at Beloit, said in a statement. "We will vigorously appeal, as the magnitude of this jury finding against Beloit is grossly excessive and has no relationship to Beloit's responsibility in the case."
